meta.WARNING: reads the CURRENT working-tree CAD constants (the elevon chord is being changed by T-101): re-run after T-101 lands
meta.units: mm unless suffixed; deg; N; N m

conventions.frame: CAD frame: x aft, y span (+y = right wing), z up, positions in mm (arm_tip_mm, horn_hole_mm, geometry.*). Side R = +y, L = -y (sy = +1 / -1).
conventions.servo_theta_deg: arm angle about the vertical spline axis at (SV_XS, sy*SERVO_Y), counter-clockwise about +z, 0 at neutral (arm tip points inboard, direction (0, -sy)).
conventions.delta_deg: elevon angle, right-handed rotation about +y through the hinge (XH, HINGE_Z): positive = trailing edge DOWN (horn hole aft/down); same sign as the plant dl/dr in the sims3d flight files.
conventions.hinge_moment_Nm: |Q| = HINGE_NM x |delta| / ELEV_LIM, HINGE_NM = 0.151 N m at VD (elevon_dynamics.py, EST); the aerodynamic moment opposes delta. Linear model only; the plant's own hinge moment (a_aero.py) is not exported here.
conventions.servo_torque_req_Nm: Q / |d theta / d delta| (hold torque, elevon_dynamics hold); rod_force_N = Q / |s_h| (rod compression or tension)
conventions.min_clearance_mm: min over all moving-vs-static and moving-vs-moving part pairs of the separating-axis separation, mm, negative = penetration; excludes the pairs in elevon_sweep_collision.EXCLUDED / STATIC_EXCL (seated joints, same part, hull artifacts). Solid hulls, holes not subtracted: a LOWER BOUND of the true clearance. *_excl_design_contact drops the declared design contacts (arm on servo case; rod on arm in zj=lo; rod on keeper in zj=hi).
conventions.rod_len_mm: distance arm tip to horn hole; constant (rigid rod) to residual_m

geometry.hinge_axis: parallel to y through (XH, HINGE_Z); servo spline axis parallel to z through (SV_XS, +-SERVO_Y)
